utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still happening today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive is collecting, and where it’s being dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: They’re collecting repair supplies and small household fixes, and the drop-off is at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — repair supplies and small household fixes, dropped off at the community center on Maple Street. Do they need anything specific packed or labeled?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to help. What do we need to line up first, Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually show up a bit late, but I can help where you need me—just tell me the first thing to line up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Dane — please start by checking the tool table and letting me know what’s missing. I’ll line up the rest while you do that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits about the repair drive, but it sounds like a good thing. What’s the latest on it, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re still collecting a few tools and fixing up the sign-up list, but it’s coming together nicely. If you need anything, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s kind of you, Gus — I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, but I’m glad it’s coming together. Let me know if there’s anything simple I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. I could really use help sorting the tools and checking what’s still fixable first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the tools and check what still looks fixable first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and let folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik—that really helps. I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep everyone posted about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive all morning — you should come by too. It’d be good to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can come by if you tell me the time and place. I like having a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s at the community center tomorrow at 6, right off Maple. I’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks are dropping off tools and supplies already. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be mighty kind of you, Tess. I’ve already forgotten half of what they asked for, so any news would help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know what’s still missing. If I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it along right quick.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first. What time and location are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact details, so I don’t want to guess. As soon as I have the time and location, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — just send them over when you get them, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it’s still moving along — I’ve got a few updates, but nothing urgent yet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—sounds like it’s steady for now. Let me know if there’s anything I should help with.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might've missed a few details—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still catching up too, honestly. I heard they’re collecting repair items and volunteers, but I don’t know the latest details yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out and see if I can find the details too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Cleo — are we still on for the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, we’re still on. Could you bring duct tape, a few screwdrivers, and any spare batteries you have?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll bring duct tape, screwdrivers, and whatever batteries I can find. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and what needs hauling before I can commit. If you have a list, I can check what I can realistically take on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t got the full list yet, but I can ask around and bring you the timing as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thanks. Once you’ve got the timing and a rough list, I can see what fits.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is the right one, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m sure — the repair drive is the one we set aside for fixes. If you want, I can bring over the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — you’re certain it’s the repair drive and not the spare one?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the biggest safety issues first, then we can handle the smaller fixes after that. I can map out the spots that need attention and give you a simple start time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Please map the safety spots and give me a start time, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and I’ll mention it to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great—word of mouth will really help. I’m sure folks will appreciate the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word and remind a couple more neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'm happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll let folks nearby know and encourage them to come by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Quinn—that means a lot. I’ll keep you posted with the details and timing so you can share them around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rosa—just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll pass them along to the neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be a little late, but I can still help with the repair drive—what’s left to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Dane. We still need help setting up the tables and sorting the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the tables and sort the tools when I get there. Just point me to where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I need to stay quiet about a few things right now. For the repair drive, I can still pitch in where it’s simple.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s okay, Uli—simple help is still a big help. I’ll keep it straightforward and let you know what fits your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. Just send me the simplest task, and I’ll do my best to fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a hammer, a screwdriver, and a couple rolls of duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring those with me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of what we still need for the repair drive. Tell me what Bo’s already covered, and I’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t covered anything yet—just send me the list and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll send over the list right now, and you can take whichever items you’re able to grab.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and point people to the sign-up? I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send people to the sign-up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with that drive. What kind of repairs are you collecting for?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — we’re mainly gathering small home repairs, like leaky faucets, loose cabinet doors, and maybe a squeaky hinge or two. I should’ve brought the list, but that’s the idea!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I could probably help with a few of those. Bring me the list when you can, and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — sorry, I’ve been a bit scattered. What do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — can you tell me the time, place, and what items they still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m sorry, Hana — I don’t have the details on me right now. Could you remind me where and when it is, and what they still need?
